summary: Frietsnijderij Tollenaar is a family-owned wholesaler in Hoek, Zeeland, that cuts fresh fries daily from potatoes grown mostly on its own fields and by nearby growers. Run by the fourth generation of a farming family, it also supplies vegetables, fruit, frying oil and dairy to food-service customers. It processes thousands of kilos of fries per week.
ownership: Family-owned, run by the fourth generation
products: Fresh-cut fries, not pre-fried or frozen, peeled or unpeeled
Fries in cut sizes from 9 mm to 14 mm (horeca page lists 6 mm to 14 mm)
Free sample bags for comparing fry sizes
Fresh and cut vegetables, fruit, herbs and cut salads
Frying oil, cheese, dairy and eggs

plants.capacity_as_stated: thousands of kilos of fries per week

markets: Restaurants, lunch venues, snack bars and caterers
Same-day delivery within Zeeuws-Vlaanderen for orders before 05:00
facts: The family has been in agriculture for more than 100 years
Processes thousands of kilos of fries per week
Production and delivery run six days a week
Dry matter of each potato lot is checked with an in-house underwater-weight test
Most potatoes come from its own fields on Zeeland clay
limitations: The legal entity name, founding year, staff numbers, turnover and exact processing capacity are not published on the pages read.
Potato varieties, acreage, storage capacity and certifications are not published.
The website gives two different fry size ranges and two different sets of contact roles.
